statusRule: READY only when every ERP 4.0 software gate is READY. Commercial/legal launch blockers and real-device/AI certification evidence are tracked separately and do not alter this software-only status.

gates.name: Ranpal AI Examiner grading engine
gates.note: Question-wise AI grading, deterministic validation, provider execution, rubric controls and mandatory human review are implemented and regression-tested.

gates.name: Automatic Red-Pen checked-copy workflow
gates.note: Draft generation, evidence-aware placement, confidence gating, score integrity, rendering, publication and portal download are implemented.

gates.name: Checked-copy resilience and automatic recovery
gates.note: Transient failures are retried with bounded exponential backoff and resolved rendered/published copies are not reopened.

gates.name: Teacher exception-only review
gates.note: Low-confidence or unpositioned annotations remain teacher-review exceptions while safe zero-exception copies auto-finalize.

gates.name: Student and parent checked-copy delivery
gates.note: Published results expose rendered checked copies to authorized student/parent portal flows.

gates.name: Connected Campus software foundation
gates.note: ERP 3.1 Connected Campus software gates are complete; external real-device and certification activation remains separately governed.

gates.name: Device Hub and retry processing
gates.note: Device connectors, governance, event processing and retry behavior are implemented and tested.

gates.name: Smart transport and ridership
gates.note: GPS/ridership safety rules, route events and transport workflows are implemented at the software layer.

gates.name: Operational health and worker failure visibility
gates.note: Readiness and operational health expose dependency and background-worker failures, including recovery after later successful runs.

gates.name: Staging role and ERP 4.0 workspace regression
gates.note: Automated staging smoke coverage includes core roles plus AI Examiner, Connected Campus, Device Hub, Transport and Meetings workspaces.

gates.name: Build, runtime and Coolify deployment gate
gates.note: CI validates API regression, PostgreSQL integration, typecheck, build, runtime operational health and multi-service Coolify-compatible container builds.

gates.name: Commercial closeout and evidence workflow
gates.note: The software path for signed-document evidence, sales WON linkage, billing/onboarding handoff and go-live evidence is implemented and QA-testable. Real client acceptance/payment remains an external commercial event and is not required for ERP 4.0 software completion.

qaPolicy: Synthetic/test acceptance and payment evidence may be used to validate software workflows, but never as evidence of a real paying client or commercial launch.
